_comment: glb-bake material map for the G31. NOTE the slide is steel_soot, not steel_black: steel_black carries the highest wear amplitude in the library (0.24) and the curvature mask is per-vertex, so on faceted low-poly geometry — where every vertex sits on a hard edge — it bleaches whole panels to bare metal. steel_soot is near-black with 0.06 wear and holds up. Verified in .shots/g31-side.png before and after. Keys resolve most-specific first: '<group>/<node>', '<node>', '<group>', then the glTF material name. Per-part keys are used here because the source reuses one glTF material across parts made of different things — Material.001 covers both the red-dot housing and the polymer grip.
